cases.kind: PREFAB STATIC PREVIEW WITH EXPLICIT SAMPLE TEXT — NOT UNITY GAMEPLAY OR ACCOUNT DATA
cases.name: static-hud-1080x1920-sample-rest
cases.interpretation: Production GameCanvas, RealGamePanel/Content and GameUiWidget instances in a disposable PreviewScene. Business behaviours, animation and audio are disabled before activation. Canvas coordinates reproduce the production MatchHeight scaler; no current Game view, account or save is read. Geometry checks are conservative rectangular estimates, not input-event tests or pixel silhouettes. Samples and currency animation extremes exist only on disposable clones.
sampleChanges: Both production currency animation targets use scale 1; the existing HorizontalLayoutGroup is kept enabled and rebuilt.
